The Strand - Hilton Saigon
Jun 2026 • Business
I had a great experience at the evening buffet at The Strand at Hilton Saigon. The buffet has many attractive choices, from fresh seafood, international dishes, baked meat boxes to beautifully presented cakes and desserts. The food is very good, the ingredients are fresh and added continuously throughout dinner.

What impressed me most was the professionalism of the staff. From the beginning of the table booking, you have been enthusiastically advising, confirming information quickly and supporting the selection of the right area for us to talk business. When we arrive at the restaurant, we are welcomed and guided to the table carefully.

During the meal, staff always cares about the experience of guests, regularly cleans dishes, support when needed and always maintain a friendly, professional attitude. The dedication of the team contributed to creating a very complete dinner. Thank you Anna, Winning helped resolve the problem quickly

Luxury restaurant space, beautiful views, quality food and excellent service gave us a memorable experience. Thank you to the entire staff of The Strand for their hospitality and professionalism. We will definitely come back and recommend the restaurant to friends and relatives.
